correctness.rationale: Stable convolution over the deterministic intervals gives the geometric weights and an independent uniform phase. At fixed phase, distinct coordinates have zero covariance. In the mixed fourth moment, products of squared components from different draws give d⁻², and terms in a single draw give 1/[d(d+2)]; terms with off-diagonal cross contractions vanish. The resulting phase mixture has covariance (v/a)^4 d⁻² times Var(S)−2 E(P)/(d+2). Direct integration of the squared- and fourth-weight sums confirms the closed formulas. For uniform k=u/θ, S=θ/2+θ²(k²−k)+O(θ³) uniformly, giving Var(S)=θ⁴/180+O(θ⁵); P=θ³/4+O(θ⁴), which dominates the fast-period sign for fixed d. At the slow end the bracket tends to −2/(d+2). Independent rational enclosure of the d=41 bracket at θ=3 gives the exact claimed positive bounds and the rational signs at θ=1 and 10. Since E(P)>0, the bracket is increasing in d at each fixed θ. The bracket is real analytic on θ>0 and not identically zero, so the opposite signs bracketing θ=3 guarantee distinct sign-changing zeros. The sufficient dimension is not a minimal-dimension theorem, and no uniqueness of either crossing is proved.
